newsitem.title: USA: Inacom launches Asset RollCall service.
newsitem.headline: Inacom launches Asset RollCall service.

text.p: Inacom Corp said Monday it introduced Inacom Asset RollCall, a service which provides reports on the technology utilized within a corporation.
Inacom software compiles a report which gives an inventory of computers and related equipment used and can help determine if the corporation has the appropriate technology in place, Inacom said.
The service can be purchased as part of a long-term technology management program, a quarterly subscription service or a one-time analysis.
